LightningComponentBundle.description: Storefront button to schedule an appointment. Opens a calendar to pick a date and time slot, then saves the booking to the logged-in user’s Person Account Description.

property.name: buttonLabel
property.label: Button label
property.description: Label for the schedule button (editable in Experience Builder).

property.name: productId
property.label: Product ID
property.description: Optional. Product2 Id when the component is on a PDP. Used to store which product the booking is for.

property.name: productName
property.label: Product name
property.description: Optional. Product name when on a PDP. Preferred over Product ID in the saved booking. Leave blank to resolve from Product ID or page context.

property.name: productId
property.label: Product ID
property.description: Optional. Product2 Id when on a product page.

property.name: productName
property.label: Product name
property.description: Optional. Product name for the booking.
